findings.detail: Two frozen artifacts disagree on the spelling of the F2a class's vocabulary values while remaining alias-equivalent. (a) conclusion_type: F0 classes.AF-SCC-C2-VAC-GEN.axes.conclusion_type = 'strong_cosmic_censorship_C2'; schema = 'scc_c2_future_inextendibility'; VOCAB_ALIASES.json (owner lead-formulation) declares the schema's value canonical and the F0 value an accepted alias whose policy is 'accepted aliases are equivalent for consistency checks only and must never appear in a new canonical artifact'. (b) genericity_kind: F0 axis = 'provisional_baire_residual' (which F0's own field_vocabulary rule calls a placeholder that 'must not be read as frozen values'); schema = 'residual_comeager' (VOCAB_ALIASES canonical, and absent from F0 field_vocabulary.genericity_kind.allowed, which lists only baire_residual/dense_open/measure_one/provisional_baire_residual/unresolved). check_taxonomy_consistency.py reports CONSISTENT because it is alias-tolerant, so the divergence is invisible to the canonical instrument. Alias-equivalence means no class-statement change; one gate-level token re-stamp decides it. The identical defect on F2b is worker-075's HF-075-F2b-VOCAB; F1 is unaffected (weak_cosmic_censorship matches F0).
findings.falsifier: A frozen adjudication that names one spelling the canonical value for both axes and re-stamps the losing artifact, or a VOCAB_ALIASES revision plus an F0 field_vocabulary revision that makes schema and F0 tokens byte-equal.

findings.detail: data_class.asymptotic_decay (lines 134-136) writes the smooth-branch rates as 'for 1 <= k <= s' and 'for 0 <= k <= s-1' while s is only defined in the sobolev_variant branch (r = (sobolev,s,delta)); under r = smooth the index s has no value. The intended reading (finitely many derivatives, or decay for all k) is clear from data_class.regularity_class.default, so the statement survives; the quantifier scope is what a careful reader would flag.
findings.falsifier: A definition of s in the smooth branch, or a rephrasing to 'all k' / 'k <= k0' at the same revision, makes the finding moot.

findings.detail: genericity.ambient_space (lines 158-161) justifies Baire-ness with 'X_vac is a closed subset of a Banach space, hence Baire' while the same field names the Frechet topology for the smooth-with-decay branch. Frechet spaces are Baire, so the conclusion (G non-empty) survives; only the justification wording is narrower than the claim.
findings.falsifier: A rephrasing that separates the Banach (Sobolev) and Frechet (smooth) branches explicitly; the mathematical conclusion is unchanged either way.
